Name: Fishing Obelisks - TheSamePlant
Author: thesameplant
Description:
[size=5]✨ [b]Adds seven new obelisk buildings, purchasable in the Wizard's house.[/b]﻿ ✨ [b]
[/b]✨ [b]Use them to warp to all of the essential fishing spots in the valley! [/b]✨ [/size][size=4][b]
[/b][/size]

[b][size=5]How to install:[/size]
[/b][size=3]Just unzip the file and add it into your mods folder!
[/size]

[size=5][b]In game use:[/b]
[/size][size=4][b]You can purchase the obelisks from the Wizard. They are considerably cheaper than the ordinary obelisks. 
[/b]
For this reason, by default, the Beach, Mountain and Desert obelisks are not available until you have built the Water, Earth and Desert obelisks, respectively.
BUT there is a way to get around that if you want to make them available immediately! You can either:[/size]
[size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]If you have the ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ mod installed, it can be edited there, and they will become immediately available (or unavailable), no need to restart your game.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Manually edit the config.json file. (It will show up once you have started the game once. It will not be there when you initially download the mod.) If you do this while your game is running, you will need to either restart your game, or use the following command in your terminal.[/size]
[/list][code]patch reload "TheSamePlant.FishingObelisks"
[/code]
✨ [size=4]UPDATE!﻿ [/size]✨ [size=2](as of 9/8/24)[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=3]You can now configure the mod so that the recipes do not require driftwood, and instead require a more easily available resource. Previously the recipes had required an unhinged amount of driftwood. You can still play with that option, and it is the default. But turning on easier recipes by configuring using the same methods as above is now an option. (Thank you to ﻿Comi﻿cguy68 for encouraging this!)[/size]

[size=3]They have magical construction, so they are built immediately, and work just the same as ordinary obelisks.

[/size][size=4]CURRENT LANGUAGE SUPPORT: 🇺🇸🇪🇸🇲🇽[/size]
English and Spanish languages. If you would like me to add translation to any other languages, please let me know!
[b](If any spanish speakers see errors in the translations, please do let me know so that I can fix them <3)[/b]

[size=5]Happy fishing! 🐠[/size]
